title.zh: 从另一列找出最后三条记录的日期
title.en: Find the Days of the Last Three Records

brief.zh: 处理完读数后，维修员还要知道最后三条记录是哪天取得的。
brief.en: The technician also needs the days of the last three measurements.

concept.zh: 不同列共用行位置。切片可以换到同一数据的另一列。
concept.en: Columns share row positions, so the same slice can be used on another column.

hints.zh: 先运行一次，再展开“查看本步输入”。清洗后共有 11 行，数一数最后三行从哪个下标开始。
hints.en: Run once and open View step input. The cleaned table has 11 rows. Count to find where the last three begin.

prompt.zh: 仅输出最后三条记录的 day 列，保留原来顺序。
prompt.en: Return only the day values from the last three records, in their original order.
